name: Rift Builder
description: Build first-person rift puzzles with friends and play them together. Place a pair of linked rifts on light panels, step through, reach the exit pad. 1 to 50 players; maps are saved to this server under your Solfray or Google account.
author: Rift Builder contributors (open source, MIT)

slots.name: skin
slots.note: classic 64x64 block-character skin: head, body, two arms, two legs in the standard layout; the outer (hat/jacket) layer is not drawn
